_comment: EXECUTIVE model for scripts/osint/exposure_score.py (--model executive), documented in analysis/weight-engine.md §7. DEDUCTIVE: a subject starts at start_score and loses max * rating / rating_max per criterion. Higher = SAFER (the opposite direction from the default composite, where higher = more exposed). Vocabulary and thresholds only, never case data (RULE 1).

settings._rating_scale: 0 = no exposure found, 1 = minor, 2 = significant, 3 = severe / fully exposed

criteria._comment: key -> {label, max, guide}. The maxima sum to start_score (100); a rating of rating_max on every criterion reaches 0.

c1.label: Digital account footprint
c1.guide: how many accounts/handles are discoverable and linkable to the subject (social, forums, app stores, code hosts)

c2.label: PII exposure
c2.guide: national ID, date of birth, personal phone/e-mail, tax or registry numbers published or leaked

c3.label: Family / close-relation exposure
c3.guide: spouse, children, relatives or close associates identifiable and themselves exposed

c4.label: Physical address & habits
c4.guide: home address, routine locations, travel patterns, geotagged media

c5.label: Corporate assets & financial exposure
c5.guide: company roles, shareholdings, registered assets, payment or banking identifiers

c6.label: Political / reputation
c6.guide: political affiliation, controversy, adverse media, litigation

c7.label: Breach records & stealer logs
c7.guide: subject identifiers in breach corpora or infostealer logs (credential exposure)

c8.label: Account & infrastructure security
c8.guide: spoofable mail domains, no MFA evidence, exposed admin surfaces of the subject's own estate

bands._comment: Lower bound (inclusive) -> band, evaluated highest first. Score >= 80 low risk, 60-79 moderate, 40-59 high, < 40 critical.
